moments.title: European Athletics Championships begin
moments.blurb: Birmingham hosts the European Athletics Championships from August 10th to 16th, bringing world-class track and field to the UK for the first time.

angles.name: Main Event Kick-off
angles.copy: Get ready, UK! The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham tomorrow. Seven days of incredible track and field action, right on home soil! Who are you cheering for? #EuroAthletics

angles.name: Birmingham Buzz
angles.copy: Birmingham is buzzing! The European Athletics Championships are here, bringing the continent's best to Alexander Stadium. Expect thrilling finals and a huge home crowd roar all week.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Manchester City face Arsenal in the FA Community Shield this Sunday, August 16th, at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Welsh Football Focus
angles.copy: Big football in Wales this Sunday! Manchester City take on Arsenal for the Community Shield at Cardiff's Principality Stadium. Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: National Build-up
angles.copy: The curtain-raiser is almost here! Arsenal vs Manchester City in the Community Shield this Sunday. A taste of what's to come for the new season!

moments.title: Premier League Season Approaching
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on August 21st, with fixtures already released, building anticipation across the UK.

angles.name: Season Countdown
angles.copy: Just under two weeks until the Premier League returns! The fixtures are out, the transfers are heating up. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Transfer Talk
angles.copy: Transfer window drama is in full swing ahead of the Premier League kick-off on August 21st. Which player moves are you most excited (or worried) about?

moments.title: Roots Picnic UK wraps up
moments.blurb: The inaugural Roots Picnic UK, a globally celebrated hip hop festival, concludes today at Crystal Palace Bowl in London after a two-day run.

angles.name: Festival Finale
angles.copy: The first ever Roots Picnic UK wraps up today at Crystal Palace Bowl! Who caught the vibes at this massive hip hop and culture festival yesterday or today?

angles.name: Global Festival Debut
angles.copy: London just hosted the international debut of Roots Picnic! Two days of world-class hip hop and unforgettable energy. What a weekend for music fans!

moments.title: The Magpies Festival this weekend
moments.blurb: The Magpies Festival returns to York from August 14th to 15th, offering a weekend of folk and roots music.

angles.name: Yorkshire Folk Fest
angles.copy: Heading to The Magpies Festival in York this weekend? Two days of brilliant folk and roots music are coming to Yorkshire! Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Weekend Escape
angles.copy: Looking for a chilled-out festival vibe? The Magpies Festival in York is on this Friday and Saturday. Perfect for a summer weekend of great live music!

moments.title: Boomtown Fair kicks off
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Fair festival takes over Hampshire from August 12th to 16th, known for its diverse music and theatrical experience.

angles.name: Immersive Festival Prep
angles.copy: Boomtown Fair is almost here! From Wednesday, Hampshire will transform into a world of music, art, and immersive theatre. Who's got their tickets ready for Chapter 13?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready for the wild ride that is Boomtown! Starting Wednesday and running all weekend, it's one of the UK's most unique festival experiences.

moments.title: Ultimate Coldplay Tributes Touring
moments.blurb: The Ultimate Coldplay tribute band is playing multiple UK dates this week, including Wolverhampton today, Stoke-on-Trent on August 14th, and Wrexham on August 15th.

angles.name: Coldplay Tribute Live
angles.copy: Did you catch Ultimate Coldplay at Exeter Phoenix last night? The tribute band is rocking Wolverhampton today and heading to Stoke & Wrexham this week!

angles.name: Wrexham Gig Alert
angles.copy: For Coldplay fans in Wales, Ultimate Coldplay are bringing their tribute show to Wrexham on Saturday, August 15th! Get ready for all the hits.

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Top 10
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'REIN ME IN' holds the top spot on the Official Singles Chart (Aug 7th), while Ariana Grande makes waves with two new tracks from 'PETAL' in the Top 10.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Big congratulations to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean, holding strong at Number 1 on the Official Singles Chart with 'REIN ME IN'! What a track.

angles.name: Ariana's Chart Impact
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's new album 'PETAL' is making a huge impact on the charts, with two tracks landing in the Official Singles Chart Top 10 this week! Which one is your favourite?

moments.title: Suzanne Vega's Birthday
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Suzanne Vega turns 67 on Monday, August 10th. Known for hits like 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner'.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suzanne
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the iconic Suzanne Vega tomorrow! Her timeless tracks like 'Luka' are still as brilliant as ever.

angles.name: Classic Artist Spotlight
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Suzanne Vega celebrates her 67th birthday! What's your favourite song from the legendary singer-songwriter? 'Tom's Diner' always gets us.

moments.title: Mark Knopfler's Birthday
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and legendary guitarist Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: A huge happy 77th birthday to the one and only Mark Knopfler this Wednesday! The Dire Straits legend's guitar work is simply iconic. What's your favourite solo?

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Wednesday marks Mark Knopfler's 77th birthday! From 'Money for Nothing' to 'Sultans of Swing,' his influence on 80s music is undeniable.

moments.title: Joe Jonas's Birthday
moments.blurb: American singer and actor Joe Jonas, known from the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, turns 37 on Sunday, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Joe Jonas turns 37 this Sunday. From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us so many bangers!

angles.name: 00s Throwback
angles.copy: Can you believe Joe Jonas will be 37 on Sunday? Take us back to the early Jonas Brothers days! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Madonna's Birthday
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on Monday, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna, this Monday! Her influence is truly unmatched. What's your go-to Madonna anthem?

angles.name: Enduring Icon
angles.copy: Still ruling the world! Madonna turns 68 on Monday. From 'Like a Prayer' to 'Vogue', she's constantly reinvented herself and inspired generations.

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle's Birthday
moments.blurb: Singer Belinda Carlisle, known for her solo hits and as lead singer of The Go-Go's, turns 68 on Tuesday, August 17th.

angles.name: Go-Go's Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 68th birthday to Belinda Carlisle this Tuesday! From The Go-Go's to her incredible solo career, she's an 80s icon. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place
angles.copy: Belinda Carlisle celebrates her 68th birthday on Tuesday! Her voice defined so many classic hits. 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' still gives us chills!

moments.title: Perseid Meteor Shower Peaks
moments.blurb: The annual Perseid meteor shower is active throughout August and peaks under a new moon, offering excellent viewing opportunities for stargazers.

angles.name: Stargazing Alert
angles.copy: Look up! The Perseid meteor shower is peaking this August, and with a new moon, conditions are perfect for spotting shooting stars. Find a dark spot tonight!

angles.name: Summer Night Sky
angles.copy: One of the best meteor showers of the year is happening now! The Perseids are putting on a show. Grab a blanket and enjoy the cosmic display.

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Build-up
moments.blurb: London's Notting Hill Carnival, celebrating 60 years in 2026, is set for August 30-31, with anticipation building for Europe's largest street festival.

angles.name: Carnival Countdown
angles.copy: It's 60 years of Notting Hill Carnival! The countdown is on for Europe's biggest street party, taking over West London on August 30th & 31st. Are you ready for the vibes?

angles.name: Cultural Celebration
angles.copy: The UK's biggest street festival, Notting Hill Carnival, is just weeks away! Get ready for incredible music, food, and culture as London prepares for its annual spectacle.
